questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Give the right-of-way to all vehicles and pedestrians in or entering the intersection. Proceed only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show which direction the road curves. This sign indicates a sharp left curve. Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the road curves right first, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells you what you must do. It means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to pass before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to upcoming hazards. It warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This white rectangular sign with black markings is a regulatory sign that you must obey. It means passing other vehicles is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to upcoming hazards. It warns you to drive carefully because the road may become slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped warning sign has a yellow background with black markings. It warns you to be extra careful when the road is wet because your vehicle will be harder to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign with black markings alerts you to upcoming hazards. It warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (such as 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop completely and yield to other traffic. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and increase your following distance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop, whether there’s a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Always yield to pedestrians in crosswalks. Watch carefully for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs indicate a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic are combining into one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a railroad crossing where the tracks are at a steep angle. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum speed allowed on the road. Drive slower if conditions like rain, snow, or ice make it unsafe to drive at the posted speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, it signals the group to stop.
